facts.text: The Penn State Schuylkill Co-Op integrates undergraduate degree studies with three full-time work experiences across all four years.

sources.title: Penn State Schuylkill Co-Op
sources.quote: Across the full four years of their undergraduate experience, students learn through integrating rigorous coursework with three full-time work experiences, and relevant career development training.
